what: A wall of photo cells flows sideways, then wraps onto a cylinder with scroll and recedes — each cell is screen width/6 × screen height/3 (1280px and up, 8 cells × 3 rows · 1024 and up /5 · 640 and up /4, 6 cells × 4 rows · below that /3, 4 cells × 6 rows) and each row flows left at 26px per second, looping endlessly. It bends from 8% to 63% as the surrounding section (parent) passes, c = ((p − .08)/.55)² fills up so the cells wrap onto a cylinder of radius screen width × .75 (angle x·c/R, receding to the cylinder’s inside) and the whole wall shrinks 1 → .7x

options.from · span: Progress where bending starts · fill length, default .08 · .55
options.radius: Cylinder radius (share of screen width), default .75
options.back: Share that shrinks when fully bent, default .3
options.[data-fx-part=stage] · [data-fx-part=til: Board holding the slots and the slot (one photo)
options.[data-fx-part=track]: (if present) section that wraps and measures progress — otherwise the parent

from.where: index.html .fd-wall (About section wall of 24 photos — original #mediaWall: [{1280,6,8,3},{1024,5,8,3},{640,4,6,4},{0,3,4,6}], g 26px/s, x = .75·innerWidth, c = ((t−.08)/.55)², scale 1−.3c, rotateY(−u), perspective 100vw)

note: The original measures section progress by the parent of the sticky panel (About section, 300vh) — the part also uses the parent (or [data-fx-part=measured with track])
